Booking.Privacy.What.Title: What we keep
Booking.Privacy.What.Contact: Your name and phone number, and your email if you give it.
Booking.Privacy.What.Visits: Your visits: what you booked, when, with whom, and what you paid.

Booking.Privacy.Shared.Helpers: The companies that run our booking system and deliver our text messages and emails. They handle your details only to do that work for us.

Booking.Privacy.HowLong.Client: We keep your details while you are our client.
